thread:
alex_k: Heads-up — customers A/B and Orion pilot both pushed back on our proposed launch scope. We need to agree on a trimmed MVP or shift timeline. Quick sync? :spiral_calendar:

maria_p: ack. can we list the non-negotiables from each side? i.e., runtime SLA vs. security HSM?

kevin_r: from runtime: 99th p99 token latency target, and KV cache warmup for tenant isolation. without those, perf will be unpredictable.

samir_s: infra: we can provide reserved capacity for pilot but it'll need a month lead and a capacity commit. also need to decide on prewarm windows so we can schedule nodes.

elaine_w: security: HSM integration and audit logs are mandatory for finance customers. we can scope a minimal audit stream (event-level) instead of full retention if that helps.

alex_k: proposal: two launch paths. Path A (fast): remove HSM from day-1, use ephemeral KMS + audit-lite, deliver runtime caching and p99 improvements. Path B (compliant): include HSM + full audit, adds 4 weeks. Which do we prioritize for the pilot?

kevin_r: opt for Path A for velocity, but we need a hard SLA on rollback if p99 regresses. we can ship cache + batching improvements behind a feature flag.

maria_p: customers asked for HSM specifically, but many are ok with a staged HSM rollout if we clearly promise timeline. i'd be comfortable with Path A if we commit to Path B schedule in writing.

samir_s: infra can commit to reserved pool for Path A if product provides the traffic profile and prewarm cadence by EOW. for Path B we'll need the commitment 2 weeks before dev start to order capacity.

elaine_w: security will accept staged HSM. requirement: legal review + KMS-to-HSM key migration plan before enabling HSM. we can draft a checklist.

infra-bot: Reminder: capacity-request template must be submitted 14 days prior to desired start date. https://redwood.internal/capacity-requests :robot_face:

alex_k: Action items then: 1) product to finalize traffic profile & prewarm cadence (owner: maria_p, due: 1859880543). 2) runtime to gate caching behind flag + provide rollback playbook (owner: kevin_r, due: 1859884143). 3) infra to prep reserved pool estimate once profile received (owner: samir_s, due: 1859887743). 4) security + legal to draft HSM migration checklist (owner: elaine_w, due: 1859887743).

maria_p: i'll run a quick customer note offering Path A with a committed Path B timeline. tagging @kevin_r for the rollback steps so i can include them in the note.

kevin_r: will add rollback steps + flag docs. sample snippet we can include:

```
# enable runtime cache flag
redwood.runtime.flags.set('tenant_cache_v2', true)
# rollback
redwood.runtime.flags.set('tenant_cache_v2', false)
```

elaine_w: i'll start the checklist. minimal items: key rotation plan, migration testing matrix, audit retention change doc, legal signoff.

samir_s: note: if customers push for HSM earlier we might need burst pool (additional cost). i'll include cost delta in the estimate.

alex_k: agreement thread: consensus leans toward Path A with signed Path B timeline. we'll publish a decision doc and update the launch checklist. thanks all — i'll circulate a short decision note and action tracker in #product after this. :white_check_mark: 

maria_p: ty! small follow-up: can runtime add a perf-run with cached vs uncached samples and share numbers by EOD tomorrow? helps commit to p99.

kevin_r: yes — i'll run two quick runs and post results in this thread.

alex_k: closing the loop: decision recorded. will ping again if anything shifts.
